headline: Blown out most of the day — Tuesday is the one to plan around.
today: Dawn and morning are trashed by 15-17mph onshore and cross-on wind on a big but short-period S. Evening backs to a NNE cross-off, but the swell's already fading by then. Not worth the drive today.

daysToWatch.note: Prime SSE angle at 3ft with light NW wind all day — glassy and clean, this is the drive that pays off.
Longer-period SE with light dawn winds — another solid clean-up window.
